en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2654 - Imran al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) that

he was asked about a Muhrim who has a wound and uses a medicine containing saffron.
Imam (as) said: "If the saffron is the dominant ingredient in the medicine, then no. But if the other ingredients are dominant, there is no harm in it."
